newsitem.title: GREECE: MAKESHIFT BOMBS DAMAGE ARMY TRUCKS IN GREECE.
newsitem.headline: MAKESHIFT BOMBS DAMAGE ARMY TRUCKS IN GREECE.

text.p: Two small bomb explosions slightly damaged two Greek army trucks loaded on a train near Athens but no one was injured, the Greek army general staff said on Wednesday.

"There were two small explosions near the Agioi Anargyroi army camp. Two military vehicles that had been loaded on a train platform and were destined for repairs suffered minor damages," it said in a statement.
Police said the crude explosive devices, made of a stick of dynamite and a slow burning fuse, were not usually used by any of Greece's known urban guerrilla groups.

They said they suspected the bombs might have been placed by youths opposing Greece's participation in the multi-national peaceforce to Albania. Greece is sending about 700 men to help restore order in the chaotic Balkan state.
